shots.prompt: Night in the hut, Kai lies on a bed, tossing and turning
lines: The Shadow had hidden her code inside Kai's mind.

shots.prompt: Red code pulses in Kai's eyes
Rain hits the hut windows, candles flicker
He explains gravely
lines: Someone must go inside his dream and bring him back.

shots.prompt: She steps forward
lines: I'll go. He came for me once.

shots.prompt: Memory lanterns rise into the sky like fireflies
Ashley holds the green pendant against Kai's forehead, light floods the room
Ashley falls into a golden dream field under two moons
lines: Inside Kai's dream, memories floated like lanterns.

shots.prompt: Ashley runs across the golden field toward a distant hill
Ashley walks among floating memory lanterns, touching one that shows two children laughing
She calls out
Red code spreads across Kai's face then retreats
Kai sits alone on a hill in the dream, staring at the moons
He doesn't turn around
lines: Go away. Everyone I remember leaves.

shots.prompt: Wind swirls around Ashley and her twin, hair flying
She sits beside him
lines: I didn't leave. I woke up and came looking for you.

shots.prompt: The pale twin rises from the shadows of the dream, red light spreading
The two moons flash brightly as the dream shakes
The golden field turns dark red, the lanterns start to go out
Ashley stands between Kai and her twin, holding out the glowing pendant
Kael holds Kai's hand, praying, light pulsing
She speaks firmly
lines: Nobody belongs to anyone. Let him go.

shots.prompt: Kai stands up beside Ashley, memories glowing around him
Nyra spins her glowing spear and launches into the sky
He smiles slowly
Golden light explodes outward and the dark shadow shatters into dust
lines: Memories are stronger than any code.

shots.prompt: Kai gasps awake in the hut, the red light gone from his eyes
Ryan cheers and jumps on the bed
The cat purrs and curls up on Kai's chest
Ava smiles with relief, wiping a tear
In the fortress, Sila slams her fist on a console, furious
lines: Send Nyra. Bring me the girl with the staff.

shots.prompt: A red-armored warrior ignites her energy spear
